feedback.goal: Provide a generic local multi-round research ledger with shared artifact dependencies, bounded reservations and separate acceptance evidence.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Plans pin comparison and research identities and finite named allocations.
Reviewed parent and compatible artifact identities support branching and shared reuse without duplicate production.
Execution outcomes and exact-result supervisor reviews remain separate; failed work can retain reviewed checkpoints.
Unknown outcomes retain active slots, failures retain reservations and observed overruns block further allocation.
Immutable linked events support idempotency, restart reconstruction and historical prefix projections.
Public CLI and library work in a clean packaged consumer without a source checkout or native model execution.
Repository checks pass with the old replay and live-text authority boundaries preserved.

outcome.summary: Implemented metadata-only campaign persistence and verified its state, accounting, privacy-shape and distribution boundaries. No model, experiment or policy activation occurred.

what_worked: A primary-parent tree plus explicit accepted artifact inputs represents shared preparation across experiment branches.
Focused tests distinguish unknown outcomes, diagnostic metrics and accepted comparable results.
Existing replay commands remain compatible with the additive artifact ledger interface.
what_failed: Initial checks exposed an outdated capsule test date and a legacy usage-message expectation; both were corrected before final verification.
Review identified stale head reporting on idempotent retries; current head and original operation sequence are now distinct.

calls.name: vitest
calls.purpose: Verify generic campaign state and failure semantics with synthetic metadata.

calls.name: repository-check
calls.purpose: Verify types, builds, regressions, capsules and offline policy scorecards.

calls.name: release-smoke
calls.purpose: Verify packaged CLI, schemas and public campaign API in a disposable consumer.

evidence.summary: All twenty-eight focused tests passed; source identity binds the executed acceptance suite.
Full check passed: typecheck, build, all fifty-eight test files, twelve hundred seventy-six passing tests, seven conditional skips, capsule checks and both offline scorecards.
Eight local package artifacts packed; clean consumer exercised artifact-campaign CLI, historical prefix and public library API without a DSH mount or model call.
Generic ledger implementation reviewed for input identity, immutable history and accounting boundaries.

uncertainty.statement: The target outer-harness adapter has not been connected to this new ledger.
uncertainty.resolution: Integrate digest-bound task and artifact receipts in the target workspace as a separate measured change.

uncertainty.statement: Recorded roles and digests do not authenticate reviewers or prove artifact existence, actual execution, physical resource enforcement or semantic privacy.
uncertainty.resolution: Keep adapter-owned independent verification and separate execution permissions; do not present ledger acceptance as model improvement or deployment authority.

notes: Implementation awaits maintainer code review. No commit, push, release publication, shared-profile edit or plugin mount was requested.
